text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyoderma Gangrenosum. The biopsy confirms neutrophilic infiltration without infection, which is the hallmark of this neutrophilic dermatosis often triggered by trauma (like the ant bite) in patients with Crohn's disease. I will recommend starting systemic immunosuppression, such as systemic corticosteroids or cyclosporine, to control the ulceration.
